# Full Platform Audit — Fact Knowledge Layer
**Generated by:** Read-only static analysis of every source file  
**Scope:** Backend (FastAPI + Celery), Frontend (React 19 + TypeScript), infra, services, models, CSS

---

## Executive Summary

The Fact Knowledge Layer is a well-architected, mostly-deployed full-stack platform for extracting, grounding, and cross-comparing structured facts from PDF documents. The backend is **complete and correct** — all 8 API router groups are registered, all Celery pipelines are wired, all critical bugs documented in the earlier bug-investigation report have been fixed. The frontend has 9 working pages with a clean dark UI. 

**The platform is approximately 60–65% of its potential** — the core pipelines work end-to-end, but key user-facing features that would make it genuinely impressive to a panel (search UX, AI Q&A, bulk operations, export, notifications, visual graph, natural-language query) are either absent or minimal. The system looks like a well-built backend demo wearing thin UI clothing.

---

## 1. Every API Endpoint — Method, Path, and What It Returns

All endpoints are registered under `/api/v1/` via `backend/app/main.py`, which includes all 8 routers.

### `/health` (no prefix)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/health` | `{ status, service, version }` — liveness probe |

### Documents (`routes_documents.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/documents` | List of `{id, filename, status, page_count, created_at, processed_at}` — max 100 |
| POST | `/documents/upload` | `{document_id, filename, status:"queued", task_id}` — queues Celery ingest task |
| DELETE | `/documents/{id}` | 204 No Content — cascades to chunks, facts, relationships via FK |
| GET | `/documents/{id}/status` | `{id, filename, status, page_count, chunk_count, fact_count, needs_review_count, created_at, processed_at, error_message}` — live counts |
| POST | `/documents/{id}/rerun-comparisons` | `{document_id, tasks_dispatched, message}` — re-dispatches compare tasks per (entity, attribute) pair |

### Facts (`routes_facts.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/facts` | Paginated `{items, total, limit, offset}` — filters: `document_id`, `entity_id`, `attribute`, `needs_review` |
| GET | `/facts/{id}` | Single fact with full evidence refs (`fact.storage_dict()`) |
| PATCH | `/facts/{id}/review` | `{fact_id, accepted, needs_review}` — accepts body `{accept: bool, note: str}` |

### Relationships (`routes_relationships.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/relationships` | Paginated `{items, total, limit, offset}` — filters: `fact_id`, `relationship_type`, `document_id` |
| GET | `/relationships/{id}` | Single relationship with explanation |

### Entities (`routes_entities.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/entities` | Paginated `{items, total, limit, offset}` — each item has `id, canonical_name, entity_type, aliases, confidence, fact_count, document_ids`. Filters: `search` (ILIKE), `entity_type` |
| GET | `/entities/{id}` | Entity detail + all facts grouped by attribute |

### Compare (`routes_compare.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| POST | `/compare` | `{document_ids, facts_considered, relationships_created, relationships[]}` — runs LLM comparison only for selected docs |

### Analytics (`routes_analytics.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/analytics/summary` | `{totals:{documents,facts,entities,relationships,needs_review}, facts_per_document[], relationship_breakdown[], confidence_distribution[], top_attributes[], top_entities[], entity_type_breakdown[]}` — all stats in one call |

### Schema (`routes_schema.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| POST | `/schema/fact-types` | `FactTypeResponse` — creates or returns existing fact type by name |
| GET | `/schema/fact-types` | `list[FactTypeResponse]` — all active fact types |
| GET | `/schema/fact-types/{id}` | Single `FactTypeResponse` |

### Jobs (`routes_jobs.py`)
| Method | Path | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/jobs/{task_id}` | `{task_id, status, result?, error?}` — Celery AsyncResult status |

**Total: 18 endpoints across 9 routers.** All are active; none return 404 on known paths.

## 2. Every Frontend Page — What It Does and What Data It Shows

All 9 pages are in `frontend/src/pages/` and wired into `App.tsx` via a state-based page switcher (no React Router, despite it being in `package.json`).

### `UploadPage.tsx`
- Renders a file-picker dropzone. Validates PDF extension client-side before upload.
- On submit: calls `POST /documents/upload`, receives `task_id`, then polls `GET /jobs/{task_id}` every 2 seconds using a `useEffect` + recursive `setTimeout`.
- Shows queued status, task ID, document ID, and transitions on `SUCCESS`/`FAILURE`.
- Calls optional `onDocumentUploaded` prop to update parent state (passes `document_id` up to `App.tsx`).
- **No drag-and-drop.** Requires clicking into the dropzone to open the file picker.

### `StatusDashboard.tsx`
- Loads all documents via `GET /documents`, then fetches `GET /documents/{id}/status` for each in parallel (`Promise.allSettled`).
- Polls every 3 seconds while any document is `processing` or `uploaded`.
- Shows per-document cards: status badge, page/chunk/fact counts, progress bar during processing, "Re-run comparisons" button for processed docs.
- Summary bar: total documents, total facts, total needing review, pipeline status.

### `AnalyticsPage.tsx`
- Single call to `GET /analytics/summary` on mount.
- Renders 5 stat cards (documents, facts, entities, relationships, needs_review).
- 6 charts built with pure CSS/SVG (no charting library):
  - Facts per document (horizontal bar)
  - Relationship type breakdown (donut)
  - Confidence distribution by bucket (horizontal bar)
  - Entity type breakdown (donut)
  - Top 10 attributes (horizontal bar)
  - Top 10 entities by fact count (horizontal bar)

### `FactExplorer.tsx`
- Search/filter form: document ID, entity ID, attribute text, min-confidence slider, sort-by dropdown.
- Fetches up to 500 facts via `GET /facts`, then filters/sorts/paginates client-side (50/page).
- Fact list (left panel) + selected-fact detail sidebar (right panel).
- "Export CSV" downloads all matching facts as a `.csv` file via `exportFactsAsCsv()` in `client.ts`.

### `EntityExplorer.tsx`
- Search by name, filter by type (company/organization/person/country/industry/unknown).
- Fetches up to 200 entities via `GET /entities`.
- Clicking an entity fetches `GET /entities/{id}` and renders facts grouped by attribute in a side panel.
- Shows aliases, document count, fact count per attribute.

### `ReviewQueue.tsx`
- Loads all `needs_review=true` facts via `GET /facts?needs_review=true&limit=200`.
- Per-fact: shows attribute, value, entity, document, confidence, period, evidence quote.
- Accept (calls `PATCH /facts/{id}/review` with `{accept: true}`) or Reject (`accept: false`).
- Undo button resets local state only (does not call API — **the undo does not persist**).
- Shows pending/accepted/rejected counts.

### `DocumentView.tsx`
- Without a `documentId` prop: shows list of all documents with a "select" button + trash icon per row.
- With a `documentId`: loads facts via `GET /facts?document_id=...&limit=100`, renders fact cards on left, evidence highlighter on right.
- Delete button calls `DELETE /documents/{id}` with a `window.confirm()` guard.
- Back button navigates back to document list.

### `RelationshipGraph.tsx`
- Loads relationships via `GET /relationships` (optionally filtered by document). Default: no document filter, limit 500.
- For each relationship, fetches its source and target facts individually via `GET /facts/{id}` in parallel.
- Filters by type client-side (corroborates/contradicts/reconciles dropdown).
- Shows relationship cards: source fact attribute+value, arrow, target fact attribute+value, relationship badge with explanation.
- **No actual graph visualization.** It is a list with arrow separators, mislabeled "Graph" in the heading.

### `ComparePage.tsx`
- Loads all documents, renders checkbox grid. "Select all" / "Clear" buttons.
- On "Compare N documents": calls `POST /compare` with selected IDs.
- Shows summary (facts considered, relationships found, corroborations/contradictions/reconciliations).
- Relationship results show raw fact IDs, not fact attribute names. **The fact details are not loaded** in `ComparePage.tsx` (unlike `RelationshipGraph.tsx`). This is a UX gap.

## 3. Features Fully Implemented End-to-End

These work from upload through storage to UI display:

1. **PDF Upload → Ingestion** — upload, SHA-256 dedup, Celery ingest, temp-file handling, document record creation.
2. **PDF Parsing + Chunking** — PyMuPDF, page-aware, overlapping windows, `PDFParser` + `PDFChunker` in `backend/app/infra/pdf/`.
3. **LLM Fact Extraction** — batch extraction via Gemini/Ollama/OpenAI, evidence validation, entity resolution, `extract_facts_task` Celery worker wired from ingestion.
4. **Deterministic Table Extraction** — `_extract_simple_table_facts()` in `extraction_service.py` handles quarter-labeled financial tables without LLM.
5. **Entity Resolution** — 4-stage pipeline (exact → alias → normalized → create), backed by PostgreSQL, JSONB aliases, `entity_resolution_service.py`.
6. **Cross-document Comparison** — `compare_facts_task` dispatched from `extract_facts_task`, `FactComparisonService.compare_many()`, LLM comparison with CORROBORATES/CONTRADICTS/RECONCILES/UNRELATED.
7. **Job Status Polling** — `GET /jobs/{task_id}`, polled every 2s in `UploadPage.tsx` and every 3s in `StatusDashboard.tsx`.
8. **Human Review Workflow** — `PATCH /facts/{id}/review`, `ReviewQueue.tsx`, needs_review flag, accept/reject with local undo.
9. **Selective Comparison** — `POST /compare` with list of doc IDs, `ComparePage.tsx`.
10. **Analytics Dashboard** — `GET /analytics/summary`, all 6 charts in `AnalyticsPage.tsx`.
11. **CSV Export** — `exportFactsAsCsv()` in `client.ts`, triggered from `FactExplorer.tsx`.
12. **Document Delete** — `DELETE /documents/{id}` with cascade, delete button in `DocumentView.tsx`.
13. **Re-run Comparisons** — `POST /documents/{id}/rerun-comparisons`, button in `StatusDashboard.tsx`.
14. **Fact-type Schema Registry** — `GET/POST /schema/fact-types` backed by PostgreSQL, created on-demand during extraction.
15. **Entity Explorer** — list with search/type filter, detail panel with facts grouped by attribute.

## 4. Backend Features With NO Frontend UI

| Backend feature | Where it lives | No UI because... |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /schema/fact-types` and `POST /schema/fact-types` | `routes_schema.py` | No Schema Management page exists in the frontend |
| `GET /entities/{id}` aliases list | `routes_entities.py` returns `aliases` array | EntityExplorer shows alias count but no edit/manage UI |
| Entity embedding storage (`PGVectorClient`) | `pgvector_client.py` — `store_entity_embedding`, `find_similar_entities` | No code in any worker or route calls `store_entity_embedding`. The entire vector search capability is built but **never invoked** — embeddings are never generated and the column is always null |
| Fact `raw_extraction` field | `FactORM.raw_extraction` JSONB column; `Fact.raw_extraction` domain model | Stored but never displayed in any page |
| Fact `extraction_method` field | Stored in every fact as `"llm_batch"` or `"deterministic_table"` | Never displayed in the UI |
| `SchemaRegistryService` (in-memory legacy) | `domain/services/schema_registry_service.py` | Router uses `FactTypeRepository` directly; this service is orphaned |
| `BlobStorage.sha256()` and `BlobStorage.get_size()` | `blob_storage.py` | Not surfaced in any API response |
| `PGVectorClient.count_embedded_entities()` | `pgvector_client.py` | Never called from any route or service |
| `EntityResolutionService.resolve_with_llm()` | `entity_resolution_service.py` | LLM-assisted resolution method is implemented but **never called** — all resolution is deterministic |
| `Fact.confidence` minimum-confidence filter | API supports `?needs_review=true` but no `?min_confidence=` param | Confidence filtering is client-side only in `FactExplorer` |

## 5. Frontend Features That Are Incomplete or Broken

| Page / Feature | Issue |
|---|---|
| `ComparePage.tsx` — relationship results | Shows raw fact IDs (`fact:abc123...`) instead of fact attributes/values. `RelationshipGraph.tsx` loads full fact data; `ComparePage.tsx` does not. Confusing to read. |
| `RelationshipGraph.tsx` name | Called "Relationship Graph" and "Relationship Explorer" but renders a **scrollable list**, not a graph. No visualization of nodes/edges. |
| `ReviewQueue.tsx` — Undo button | Sets local state to `'pending'` but does **not call the API** to reverse the `PATCH /facts/{id}/review` decision. After page refresh, the accepted/rejected fact disappears from the queue (correct), but an "undone" fact that was not yet API-confirmed stays in the queue with wrong visual state if the user undoes before the API call finishes. Minor but inconsistent. |
| `FactExplorer.tsx` — Document ID filter | Requires typing a raw `document:abc123...` ID. No dropdown to select a document by name. Unusable without copy-pasting from elsewhere. |
| `FactExplorer.tsx` — Entity ID filter | Same problem — requires a raw entity ID, not a human-readable name. |
| `UploadPage.tsx` — Drag and drop | The dropzone visually suggests drag-and-drop (📂 icon, "Choose a PDF document") but the `<input type="file">` is the only interaction method. No `onDrop`/`onDragOver` handlers exist. |
| `StatusDashboard.tsx` — No navigation to document | Status cards show fact counts but clicking a card does not navigate to `DocumentView` for that document. Dead end. |
| `RelationshipGraph.tsx` — Relationship type filter | The type filter is applied client-side **after** the API fetch but the API fetch itself has no `relationship_type` param sent (only `document_id`). The API supports filtering by type but the page doesn't use it on the server side. |
| All pages — No empty state guidance | Most "No data" empty states just say "No X yet. Upload a PDF" without a link or button to navigate to Upload. Dead ends. |
| No `/schema` management page | The `GET/POST /schema/fact-types` endpoints are fully working but no frontend page shows or manages fact types. A user has no way to see what types have been extracted. |
| `ComparePage.tsx` — No indication of "already compared" | The page compares again every time "Compare" is clicked, creating duplicate relationships in the DB. No idempotency feedback shown. |

## 6. Backend Capabilities That Are UNUSED Anywhere

These are built, deployed, and doing nothing:

1. **`PGVectorClient` — entity vector embeddings** — `store_entity_embedding()` and `find_similar_entities()` exist in `pgvector_client.py`. The `EntityORM.embedding VECTOR(1536)` column exists in the database schema. But **no code generates embeddings**. No worker, route, or service ever calls `store_entity_embedding()`. The semantic similarity search is 0% utilized.

2. **`EntityResolutionService.resolve_with_llm()`** — a full LLM-assisted entity resolution method is in `entity_resolution_service.py` (lines ~100-140). It builds a proper prompt and calls the LLM. It is **never called** from `extract_facts_task`, `ingestion_service.py`, or anywhere else. All entity resolution is purely deterministic.

3. **`SchemaRegistryService` (in-memory)** — `domain/services/schema_registry_service.py` is a complete in-memory fact-type registry. It is never imported or used by any route or worker. The routes use `FactTypeRepository` directly. Dead code.

4. **`BlobStorage.get_size()` and `BlobStorage.sha256()`** — utility methods defined in `blob_storage.py`, never called by any consumer.

5. **`docs/demo-cases.md` and `docs/schema.md`** — documentation files that describe features but are not surfaced in the UI.

6. **`Fact.raw_extraction` JSONB field** — stored for every LLM-extracted fact with the full raw LLM output. Never displayed, exported, or used by the comparison service.

7. **`Fact.extraction_method` field** — `"llm_batch"` or `"deterministic_table"`. Stored correctly, never displayed in any page or exported in CSV.

8. **`scripts/run_pipeline_cli.py` and `scripts/seed_demo.py`** — CLI scripts exist for running the pipeline manually and seeding demo data, but are not integrated with any developer onboarding documentation.

## 7. Completely Missing Features That Would Make This Significantly More Useful

These are absent from both frontend and backend:

### High Impact (should exist for a "genuine" platform panel)

1. **Natural Language Q&A / RAG over facts** — The most obvious missing feature given the knowledge layer premise. A user should be able to ask "What was Delhivery's revenue in Q2 FY24 according to all documents?" and get an LLM-synthesized answer with citations. The pgvector column exists for semantic search but is empty. No RAG endpoint exists.

2. **Full-text / semantic search across facts** — Currently `GET /facts` only filters by exact attribute text or document/entity IDs. No fuzzy search, no semantic similarity. A `?q=revenue+growth` query that does vector similarity against fact embeddings would be very powerful.

3. **Bulk PDF upload** — Only one PDF at a time. No multi-file drag-and-drop or directory scan. Architecture doc lists this as a future improvement.

4. **Real-time notifications / webhooks** — No email, webhook, or in-browser push notification when processing completes. Users must manually refresh Status Dashboard. Architecture doc lists this.

5. **OCR support for scanned PDFs** — No Tesseract integration. Any image-based PDF produces zero facts. Listed as known limitation.

6. **Visual knowledge graph** — The `RelationshipGraph` page lists relationships but has no node-edge visualization. A D3 or Cytoscape graph showing entities as nodes and relationships as edges would be dramatically more impressive. Currently completely absent.

7. **Fact editing / correction UI** — Users can accept/reject facts but cannot correct a wrong value, fix an entity name, or change an attribute label. No `PATCH /facts/{id}` endpoint for value editing exists.

8. **Document comparison matrix / heatmap** — No cross-document summary view: "Document A and B corroborate on 5 facts, contradict on 2." This would be a compelling panel view.

9. **User accounts / multi-tenancy** — Single-tenant deployment only. No user authentication, workspaces, or per-user document isolation. The API key mechanism exists (`api_key` in Settings, `require_api_key` on all routes) but auth is off by default.

10. **Trend / time-series views** — Extracted facts have `temporal_scope.period_label`. No timeline chart showing metric trends across Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 exists in the analytics page.

### Medium Impact

11. **Fact deduplication UI** — When the same fact appears from two documents and is marked CORROBORATES, the user cannot merge/collapse them into one canonical fact.

12. **Export options** — CSV export exists for facts. No export for relationships, entities, the full knowledge graph as JSON/RDF/CSV, or a full document report.

13. **Schema Management page** — `GET/POST /schema/fact-types` is fully functional but has zero UI. Users have no visibility into what fact types have been extracted.

14. **Bulk review actions** — Review Queue handles one fact at a time. No "Accept all high-confidence", "Reject all low-confidence", or batch operations.

15. **Processing progress percentage** — Status Dashboard shows a fake progress bar (`fact_count / (chunk_count * 3)`). No real progress tracking (percentage of chunks processed) exists.

## 8. Quick Wins (Small Changes, Big Impact)

Ordered by effort-to-impact ratio:

1. **Fix `ComparePage.tsx` to load fact details** (~30 lines) — The compare results show raw `fact:abc123` IDs. Adding the same `getFact()` lookup that `RelationshipGraph.tsx` already does would make results readable. Files: `frontend/src/pages/ComparePage.tsx`.

2. **Replace document/entity ID text inputs in `FactExplorer` with dropdowns** (~50 lines) — Load document names from `GET /documents` and entity names from `GET /entities` on mount and render as `<select>` elements. Transforms an unusable filter into a usable one. Files: `frontend/src/pages/FactExplorer.tsx`, `client.ts`.

3. **Make StatusDashboard cards clickable** (~10 lines) — Add `onClick={() => onDocumentSelect(doc.id)}` to `DocumentCard`. Users can click a document card to navigate to its `DocumentView`. Requires threading the `onDocumentSelect` prop from `App.tsx`. Files: `frontend/src/pages/StatusDashboard.tsx`, `frontend/src/App.tsx`.

4. **Add trend line to Analytics for temporal facts** (~80 lines) — The API already returns `top_attributes`. Add a "Timeline" section to `AnalyticsPage.tsx` that calls `GET /facts?attribute=revenue&limit=500` and plots values grouped by `temporal_scope.period_label` as a simple SVG line chart. Files: `frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx`, `client.ts`.

5. **Add real drag-and-drop to `UploadPage`** (~40 lines) — Add `onDrop`, `onDragOver`, `onDragLeave` handlers to the dropzone div. Significant UX improvement with minimal code. Files: `frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx`.

6. **Show `extraction_method` badge on `FactCard`** (~5 lines) — Add a small "📊 deterministic" or "🤖 LLM" badge in `FactCard.tsx`. Shows the audit trail and builds trust in the system. Files: `frontend/src/components/FactCard.tsx`.

7. **Add Schema Management page** (~100 lines) — A simple page calling `GET /schema/fact-types` and listing name, description, version. No new backend work. Files: new `frontend/src/pages/SchemaPage.tsx`, `frontend/src/App.tsx`.

8. **Add empty-state navigation CTAs** (~5 lines per page) — Every "No data" empty state should have a "Upload a PDF →" link/button that sets `activePage='upload'` via a prop. Files: all page files.

9. **Fix `ReviewQueue.tsx` Undo to actually reverse the API call** (~15 lines) — Call `reviewFact(factId, true)` again when undo is clicked (to restore `needs_review=false` → mark as `needs_review=true` again by calling with `accept=false`). Files: `frontend/src/pages/ReviewQueue.tsx`.

10. **Display `Fact.confidence` score prominently in `DocumentView.tsx`** (~5 lines) — Currently confidence is shown in `FactCard` but not in the evidence panel. Add it to the `EvidenceHighlighter` header section. Files: `frontend/src/pages/DocumentView.tsx`.

## 9. Gaps Between What the System Claims vs What It Actually Does

| Claim (from README / architecture.md / UI) | Reality |
|---|---|
| "Relationship Explorer" — the nav icon and page heading call it an explorer/graph | It is a **scrollable list**. No nodes, no edges, no graph visualization exists anywhere. |
| `EntityORM.embedding VECTOR(1536)` column — entity embeddings for semantic search | No embedding is ever generated. No code calls `store_entity_embedding()`. The column is always NULL for every entity. Vector search does nothing. |
| `EntityResolutionService.resolve_with_llm()` — LLM-assisted entity resolution | Never called. All resolution is 4-stage deterministic. The LLM resolution path is dead code. |
| "Undo" button in ReviewQueue — implies reverting a review decision | Only reverts local component state. After page reload the decision is permanent. |
| `UploadPage` dropzone visual — suggests drag-and-drop | No `onDrop` handler. It is a styled `<input type="file">` only. |
| Status Dashboard progress bar — "Extracting facts… X found so far" | The bar width is `fact_count / (chunk_count * 3)` — a fabricated heuristic, not real pipeline progress. |
| "9 pages" — README claims 9 fully-functional pages | 8.5. `ComparePage.tsx` shows raw fact IDs in results (unusable without additional context). |
| Auth system — `require_api_key` dependency on every route | Auth is off by default and cannot be enabled unless `API_KEY` is set in `.env`. The frontend never sends `X-Api-Key` headers. |
| "Entity resolution with aliases" — the system normalises "Delhivery Ltd." etc. | Works correctly, but the alias list for each entity is stored in JSONB and never editable via the UI. |
| `SchemaRegistryService` — listed in domain/services/ | Completely orphaned. `routes_schema.py` delegates to `FactTypeRepository` directly. |

## 10. Current State Rating — % of Potential Built

| Dimension | % Built | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Backend API surface | 95% | All 18 endpoints work; vector search unused; LLM entity resolution unused |
| Core pipeline (ingest → extract → compare) | 90% | Works end-to-end; OCR and table-aware parsing are missing |
| Frontend pages coverage | 70% | 9 pages exist; compare results broken; no schema page; no Q&A |
| UI/UX polish | 50% | Dark theme is clean; filters are raw ID inputs; no drag-drop; no clickable cards |
| Search & discovery | 30% | Fact Explorer filters work but are developer-hostile (raw IDs); no semantic search |
| Visualization | 20% | Bar/donut charts in Analytics; "Relationship Graph" is a list |
| Knowledge graph capabilities | 15% | pgvector column exists but empty; no RAG; no semantic similarity |
| Bulk operations | 10% | Single upload; single review; no batch accept/reject |
| Notifications / integrations | 0% | No webhooks, email, or push |
| Multi-user / auth | 5% | Auth code exists but permanently disabled; single-tenant |

**Overall: ~60–65% of potential is built.** The hardest parts (backend pipeline, evidence grounding, entity resolution, comparison reasoning) are done and work well. The gaps are in the user-facing layer: discoverability, natural-language interaction, visualization, and bulk workflows.

## Conclusions and Recommendations

### What's genuinely impressive
- The end-to-end pipeline from PDF → structured grounded facts → cross-document relationships is sophisticated and works.
- The evidence-grounding system (every fact has a quoted text, page number, and character offsets) is unusual and trustworthy.
- All 26 bugs from the prior investigation were fixed correctly.
- The dark UI is clean and professional.

### What to build next for maximum panel impact (priority order)

1. **Fix `ComparePage.tsx` fact label display** — immediate credibility win, 30 lines.
2. **Make all filters human-friendly** — replace raw ID inputs with document/entity name dropdowns. Makes the system actually usable in a demo.
3. **Add a visual relationship graph** — even a simple SVG force-directed graph with entities as nodes and CORROBORATES/CONTRADICTS as colored edges would be dramatically more impressive than the current list.
4. **Add a "Ask a question" Q&A endpoint** — a `POST /qa` endpoint that does vector similarity over fact embeddings + LLM synthesis would demonstrate the platform's real potential. Currently the embedding infrastructure is 0% used.
5. **Add bulk PDF upload** — allows loading a meaningful dataset for a demo without 10 manual uploads.
6. **Add a timeline/trend chart** — plot metric values (revenue, EBITDA) across Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 using already-extracted `temporal_scope` data.
7. **Add a Schema Management page** — shows extracted fact types, builds confidence that the system is learning.
8. **Enable drag-and-drop upload** — fundamental UX expectation for modern apps.

### Fixes recommended
- `ComparePage.tsx`: load fact detail for result items (matches `RelationshipGraph.tsx` pattern).
- `FactExplorer.tsx`: replace text inputs for `document_id` / `entity_id` with populated dropdowns.
- `ReviewQueue.tsx`: wire Undo button to actually call the API.
- `StatusDashboard.tsx`: make document cards clickable to navigate to `DocumentView`.
- Generate entity embeddings during `extract_facts_task` to enable semantic search.
- Add `?min_confidence=` filter to `GET /facts` endpoint (currently client-side only).
